title: BLS12-381 G2 pairing accumulator group order mismatch in multi-signature aggregation
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0464: BLS12-381 G2 pairing accumulator group order mismatch in multi-signature aggregation
Repository: `dalek-cryptography/curve25519-dalek`
Category: `Zero-Knowledge & Cryptographic Constraints`
Target File: `bls/signature.go`

#### Problem Description
Aggregated signature verification fails to check subgroup membership for rogue-key attack defense.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Enforce G2 subgroup membership test via Frobenius endomorphism map on all input signatures.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0464.py -q`
expected_invariant: Enforce G2 subgroup membership test via Frobenius endomorphism map on all input signatures.
